name: source
description: Versioned private Page source contract. Plane converts persisted Page editor content to a canonical safe projection before Knowledge ingestion; this document is the digest-bound identity of that contract.

rules.identity: stable external identity per source; version-fenced content upsert replaces obsolete chunks atomically
rules.content: canonical Markdown/HTML plus attachments and metadata; Yjs binary and unsafe editor payloads are stripped
rules.links: canonical Plane URLs are generated server-side only
rules.revision: source-revision fencing: stale work can never overwrite a newer revision
rules.deletion: permission restriction, archive, and delete produce immediate Plane-side deny plus provider tombstone
